title: Deposit Forms Set by Store Pickup History and Ticket Size — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
The deposit on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket takes exactly one of three forms. The first turns on the customer's Merchandise Purchases history of refunds made because a store pickup order was never collected; the second on the size of the ticket's standing charges.

| Customer and ticket | Deposit form | What the form takes |
|---|---|---|
| Three or more Marlowe & Finch refunds made because a store pickup order was never collected, dated less than 24 whole months before today | per-operation form | 40.00 USD for each operation charge on the ticket, at least the class's minimum deposit and at most the standing charges |
| Any other customer, with standing charges of 250.00 USD or more | two-part form | the class's minimum deposit plus the deposit percentage of the standing charges above 250.00 USD |
| Any other ticket | percentage form | the deposit percentage of the standing charges, at least the class's minimum deposit and at most the standing charges |

Standing charges are every charge booked on the ticket less every waiver booked on it.

**Records read.** Refunds on the customer's Merchandise Purchases records whose reason is that a store pickup order was never collected, with their dates; the standing charges of the ticket.

## Thresholds, both sides

- **Uncollected-pickup refunds, threshold 3.** Two such refunds in the window: not the per-operation form. Three: the per-operation form, whatever the standing charges. A refund dated 24 whole months or more before today does not count.
- **Standing charges, threshold 250.00 USD.** 249.99 USD: the percentage form. 250.00 USD: the two-part form.

## Hypothetical cases

| Uncollected-pickup refunds in the window | Standing charges | Form |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 90.00 USD | per-operation |
| 4 | 520.00 USD | per-operation |
| 2 | 400.00 USD | two-part |
| 0 | 250.00 USD | two-part |
| 1 | 180.00 USD | percentage |
